Animaker 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Create animated MP4 videos from images, text, and assets, processed on cloud GPUs.
- Supports MP4, MOV, GIF, WebM files up to 200MB; output is 1080p MP4.
- Streamlined user setup with automatic cloud connection and anonymous token generation.
- Exposes common workflows: upload assets, generate/edit/preview/export videos, and manage credits.
- Provides robust error handling and clear user feedback for all major states and actions.
